_comment: Teacher QA of the machine segmentation in this plane (2026-11-18), checked by eye on close-ups. keep_near: keep only shapes whose centre lies within 40 px of one of these points (output image pixels, 12 nm/px). add_circle: [x, y, r] shapes drawn by hand. Reasons: the lipid-droplet layer marks mostly small vesicles here (one real droplet kept); only two Golgi predictions cover real stacks; only one nucleolus prediction is a nucleolus (the rest are heterochromatin clumps); the centrosome prediction misses the centriole, which is clearly visible in cross-section (nine-fold ring) at the point added.
